subject: Decision criteria: latency/cost & deployment mode - follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finova.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Decision criteria: latency/cost & deployment mode - follow-up

Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier — appreciate the clear context on your use case (real-time claim triage + summarization). Quick recap from our side and a couple of clarifying questions so we can map stakeholders and next steps: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Primary workload: multi-turn summarization + short generation (avg. 150 tokens, bursts to 512 tokens)
- Current target: near-real-time responses in customer-facing UI
- Preference: security and data isolation are important (Finova mentioned VPC/private deployment as an option)

Clarifying asks (so we can propose the right configuration and SLA):
1) Latency targets: do you have a P95 or P99 SLA in mind for the 150-token and 512-token profiles? (e.g., P95 < 300-800ms)
2) Cost sensitivity: is there an internal cap or target for per-1k-token inference cost we should be aware of?
3) Deployment preference: are you leaning toward Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) or Private (VPC/on-prem)? Any hard constraints from security/procurement?
4) Stakeholder map: who should we loop in for security questionnaire (Priya?), procurement (Michael/procurement@finova.com), and final economic decision (CFO/EC)?

Proposed next steps:
- I can send a short benchmarking note (latency/throughput for the model family we discussed) and a sample SLA for Dedicated & Private options.
- If helpful, we can run a quick perf test with a small sample set (1-2 days) to validate P95 numbers on your representative prompts.

I attached a quick performance summary and a draft SLA that spell out latency tiers & fallback behavior. Will follow up with a proposed time for a 30-min meeting to align stakeholders.

Thanks —
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-performance-summary-20260624.pdf, redwood-sample-sla.pdf

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@finova.com>, Michael O'Neill <michael.oneill@finova.com>, Finova Procurement <procurement@finova.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Decision criteria: latency/cost & deployment mode - follow-up

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few answers and notes from our side: 

Stakeholders (to confirm):
- Priya Shah — Head of Security (will own questionnaire/KMS & VPC requirements)
- Michael O'Neill — CFO (economic buyer for Dedicated/Private commit)
- Procurement (procurement@finova.com) — contract and SOW redlines

Requirements & preferences:
- Latency: target is P95 < 800ms for 512-token-style bursts, and ideally P95 < 300-400ms for the common 150-token flows. If those are not achievable on Private infra we need clear tradeoffs on cost vs. latency.
- SLA: uptime + latency SLO with credits is required (we typically push for financial remedies on availability).
- Deployment: leaning toward Private (VPC) due to data residency and control; Dedicated is acceptable if we can get full network isolation and KMS integration.
- Security: Priya will need the completed security questionnaire and SOC2 evidence. I've attached the questionnaire we use (attached: finova-security-questionnaire.pdf).

Cost: Michael is sensitive to per-1k-token spend — rough internal target is to keep inference unit economics within 30% of our current vendor spend. We can share rough numbers in the next call.

Next steps:
1) Please provide the benchmark note and sample SLA (good that you already attached).
2) Can you propose a 30-45 minute slot next week with Priya and procurement included? Priya is available Wed/Thu morning ET.
3) We'll need a short plan for an initial perf run (scope, data, duration, telemetry we need).

Thanks — Alex
Alex Turner | Director of Product 
Alex.Turner@finova.com | +1 (646) 555-6622

Subject: Re: Decision criteria: latency/cost & deployment mode - follow-up

Alex / team — thanks for the quick clarifications, very helpful. 

I've mapped stakeholders on our side and propose how we proceed: 
- Priya: we'll send the SOC2 artifacts, a KMS integration brief, and a VPC/network topology guide. Neha will lead security questionnaire responses.
- Michael / Procurement: Vivek will own commercial terms and will prepare a draft T&Cs + commitment options (monthly reserved vs. 12/24-month).

Perf & SLA proposal:
- Latency: we'll run an initial benchmark targeting your two profiles (150 token common flow, 512 token burst). We'll aim to demonstrate P95 numbers and provide guidance on Dedicated vs Private tradeoffs.
- SLA: attached is the sample SLA. Key callouts: latency tiers, failover behavior (fallback to lower-cost variant), and credit policy. We can tailor remedies for contract negotiation.
- Perf run plan (proposed): 48-hour run, 5k representative requests (you can give a small sample), capture P50/P95/P99, cold-starts, and concurrency behavior. Redwood will provide logs/trace access for your telemetry team.

Proposed meeting times (ET):
- Wed Jul 8, 10:30-11:15am ET
- Thu Jul 9, 9:00-9:45am ET
Please confirm which works for Priya/Michael/procurement and we'll send a calendar invite + agenda.

Next actions on our side (today):
- Neha: start on the security questionnaire and share a first draft by EOD tomorrow.
- Vivek: draft commercial options and an outline of Dedicated vs Private pricing buckets.
- Marissa: coordinate perf plan and send an instrumentation checklist for the sample prompts.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Priya & procurement looped in.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

All — thanks, that timeline looks good. Priya and procurement confirmed Thu Jul 9 at 9:00am ET. Michael will join if available.

A couple quick asks before the meeting: 
- Neha: great if you can share the first pass of the security questionnaire answers ahead of the call (even bullets) so Priya can triage.
- Marissa/Vivek: please include the perf run scope and a short table with expected P95 buckets (150 token / 512 token) and cost ranges for Dedicated vs Private so Michael has something to review.

We'll send a calendar invite shortly. Looking forward to it.

Alex
